items.title: Sheila Jordan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: and Sheila liked that concert we did, our first concert, so well that she asked Joe Fields to release it and he did, and it‟s our first record.

ctx.x: there with all the equipment, we said, “Well, let‟s record the duo concert, too.” And he recorded three concerts. They did three concerts in three different Belgian towns on three successive days. This was quite a, quite a thing to try to do. That was the festival. That‟s how they set the festival up.
Uh-huh. Brown, C.: Anyway… and Sheila liked that concert we did, our first concert, so well that she asked Joe Fields to release it and he did, and it‟s our first record.
